text:
maria: Heads-up — running into client-side throttling mess in our sample app. Streaming chat + long responses + retries = bursty concurrent requests, hitting 429s from hosted API. Anyone seen best-practice for backpressure in SDKs? Trying to keep DX parity between python/js.

alex: For node SDK we use a simple token-bucket limiter. Keeps concurrency + rate under target. Example:
```js
const limiter = new TokenBucket(100, 1) // capacity, refillPerSec
await limiter.remove(1)
// send request
```
Works with streaming by holding on sending new streams until bucket allows.

sam: FYI auth retries are making this worse. If token refresh triggers a retry, we sometimes re-send the same streaming request and the backend counts it as new session. Need idempotency keys for stream starts.

irene: Found bug in node SDK: pagination helper fires 5 parallel page fetches despite concurrency option. Patch incoming. PR #542.

maria: Could we standardize on a backpressure primitive in SDKs? e.g., .withConcurrency(n) and a built-in retry policy that respects Retry-After headers and doesn't re-open streams?

alex: +1. Proposed API: client.withRateLimiter({ maxInflight: 4, tokensPerSecond: 50 }). Also respect 429 Retry-After; don't backoff by jitter alone when header present.

devex-bot: Shared sample app: https://internal.redwood.dev/devex/samples/throttling-demo — includes python/js implement of token bucket + streaming demo :rocket:

sam: Logs from incident:
```text
2026-03-09T14:23:01Z WARN request 429 retrying after 3s
2026-03-09T14:23:04Z ERROR stream aborted duplicate start
```

irene: For pagination suggestion: add cursor-queue that ensures only N inflight page fetches and exponential backoff per cursor. I'll add tests.

maria: Can we add a short guide in onboarding that mentions client-side throttling patterns and sample app? I'm seeing users stumble.

alex: I'll add a small section in SDK readme + examples in quickstart.

sam: Also add note about using idempotency_key header for non-stream requests and 'stream-session-id' for streaming sessions.

maria: Thanks. Follow-ups: alex will open SDK issues for python/node parity; irene will push patch; sam will file auth-retry ticket. I'll draft onboarding blurb.

alex: Filed issues: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/issues/876 and https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-py/issues/432
